verdict.rationale: The only document-generation evidence is the Lowenstein x Clerky partnership. It runs on a third-party platform, is framed for "clients," and is paid ($299 pay-per-use, $149 83(b) add-on). Nothing shows free, publicly downloadable incorporation documents, SAFEs, term sheets or NDAs available to non-clients, so this is an adjacent paid offering rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client
